interface.description: Network interface to capture traffic on (e.g., eth0, ens33)

filter.description: BPF filter expression to select packets (e.g., 'host 10.0.0.1 and port 443'). Empty string captures all.

key_file.description: Path to the SSL/TLS private key file (OpenSSL PEM format) for decryption. Empty if not decrypting.

key_password.description: Password for the SSL key file. Empty if no password or no key file.

ssl_key_log_file.description: Path to the SSLKEYLOGFILE (Mozilla NSS format) for TLS 1.3 decryption. Empty if not used.

print_absolute_timestamps.description: Print absolute timestamps instead of relative (-e)

connection_pool_clean_freq.description: Number of packets after which a connection pool cleaning is performed (-F)

print_full_header.description: Print the full SSL packet header (-H)

no_resolve.description: Don't try to resolve host names from IP addresses (-n)

parse_asn1.description: Attempt to parse ASN.1 when it appears (-N)

no_promiscuous.description: Don't put the interface into promiscuous mode (-P)

quiet.description: Quiet mode, only print summary lines (-q)

read_dump_file.description: Path to a PCAP dump file to read from instead of network (-r)

ssl_flags.description: SSL flags to print: crypto, d, ht, H. Comma or space separated if multiple. (-S)

inactive_conn_ttl.description: TTL for inactive connections in seconds (-t)

print_hex.description: Print each record in hex, as well as decoding it (-x)

suppress_printable_hex.description: Suppress printable characters in hex dump (-X)

write_pcap.description: Destination file for decrypted packets in pcap format (-w)
